name: Building thriving communities: Promoting brain and mental health

content.title: Building thriving communities: Promoting brain and mental health
content.summary: BMI to host hybrid global conference, November 3-5, 2025

media.alt: Building thriving communities: Promoting brain and mental health

content.text: Karachi, Pakistan  - The Aga Khan University's Brain and Mind Institute (BMI) will host its annual conference, themed "Building Thriving Communities: Promoting Brain and Mental Health," from November 3-5, 2025, at the Aga Khan University (AKU) campus in Karachi, Pakistan. The hybrid event will bring together researchers, policymakers, health professionals, educators and community leaders from across Asia, Africa and beyond to explore innovations and collaborations that advance mental health and brain science for community well-being.

The conference reflects BMI's mission to strengthen mental and brain health systems through interdisciplinary research, education and innovation, guided by the Institute's ethos "From Neuron to Neighbourhood."

"Promoting brain and mental health is not only a scientific or clinical challenge, but also a societal imperative," said Professor Zul Merali, Founding Director of the Brain and Mind Institute. "Our goal through this conference is to catalyze collaboration across disciplines and geographies so that we can translate cutting-edge research into practical solutions that improve people's lives and help communities thrive."

This year's conference will feature plenary sessions, panel discussions and workshops spotlighting emerging research on mental health promotion, early intervention, neuroscience-informed policy and community resilience. Special attention will be given to youth mental health, digital innovation and the role of social determinants in shaping mental well-being across the lifespan.

"At the heart of our work is the belief that strong, healthy communities are built when mental well-being is prioritized as a shared responsibility," said Professor Rozina Karmaliani, Associate Director of BMI, Pakistan. "This gathering will allow us to share evidence, experiences and hope, and to work together toward policies and practices that protect and promote mental health for all."

Participants will include leading experts from the Aga Khan Development Network and international partner institutions in the UK, USA, Africa and South Asia. The hybrid format will allow for broad participation through both in-person sessions in Karachi and online engagement via live streaming and interactive virtual discussions.

The conference builds on BMI's ongoing efforts to integrate mental health into health, education and community systems, contributing to the global movement for equitable and accessible mental health care.
*Venue: Aga Khan University, Karachi, Pakistan (Hybrid Event)
*Theme: Building Thriving Communities: Promoting Brain and Mental Health
*Hosted by: The Aga Khan University's Brain and Mind Institute
